channels: riceEdgeDistance (0.5 = edge of the rice, +-2 m)

channelMask.encoding: distance (m) from each texel centre to the nearest open stretch of a brook-fed canal = value/255*range; row 0 is z=-750, texel 0.5 m; the ground is drawn open where the distance is below openBelow (the heightfield closes over the channel at the wall tops)

environment.notes: Sun position from a standard solar position algorithm (NOAA approximation).

river.note: cross-sections along X centred on the bed; the water's edge is where waterY meets the terrain; fall=1 rows are the crest and foot of an overfall

bed.format: [xCentre, z, halfWidth, bankTopY, toeYWest, toeYEast, earthWest, earthEast, facingWest, facingEast]
bed.note: earth=1: natural earth bank (1:0.9 cut bank outside a bend to 1:2.3 inside it); earth=0: masonry revetment 1:0.4 from the toe to the bank top; facing: 0 old mossy dry stone, 1 concrete kenchi blocks, 2 cut granite (kenchi-ishi)

terrace.note: the river's floodplain (low terrace) lies 2.2-3.3 m below the paddy floor (drop: range); in places a middle terrace stands between them. scarps: the line half way up each terrace scarp, x/z, level main|middle, ticks towards the river
